versos.grego: Περὶ δὲ ὧν ἐγράψατε, καλὸν ἀνθρώπῳ γυναικὸς μὴ ἅπτεσθαι·

controles.web: Now concerning the things about which you wrote to me: it is good for a man not to touch a woman.
controles.kjv: Now concerning the things whereof ye wrote unto me: It is good for a man not to touch a woman.
controles.livre: E sobre as coisas que me escrevestes, bom é para o homem não tocar mulher.

versos.grego: διὰ δὲ τὰς πορνείας ἕκαστος τὴν ἑαυτοῦ γυναῖκα ἐχέτω, καὶ ἑκάστη τὸν ἴδιον ἄνδρα ἐχέτω.

controles.web: But, because of sexual immoralities, let each man have his own wife, and let each woman have her own husband.
controles.kjv: Nevertheless, to avoid fornication, let every man have his own wife, and let every woman have her own husband.
controles.livre: Mas por causa dos pecados sexuais, tenha cada um sua própria mulher, e cada uma tenha seu próprio marido.

versos.grego: τῇ γυναικὶ ὁ ἀνὴρ τὴν ὀφειλὴν ἀποδιδότω, ὁμοίως δὲ καὶ ἡ γυνὴ τῷ ἀνδρί.

controles.web: Let the husband render to his wife the affection owed her, and likewise also the wife to her husband.
controles.kjv: Let the husband render unto the wife due benevolence: and likewise also the wife unto the husband.
controles.livre: Que o marido satisfaça sua mulher como devido, e semelhantemente a mulher ao marido.

versos.grego: ἡ γυνὴ τοῦ ἰδίου σώματος οὐκ ἐξουσιάζει ἀλλὰ ὁ ἀνήρ· ὁμοίως δὲ καὶ ὁ ἀνὴρ τοῦ ἰδίου σώματος οὐκ ἐξουσιάζει ἀλλὰ ἡ γυνή.

controles.web: The wife doesn’t have authority over her own body, but the husband. Likewise also the husband doesn’t have authority over his own body, but the wife.
controles.kjv: The wife hath not power of her own body, but the husband: and likewise also the husband hath not power of his own body, but the wife.
controles.livre: A mulher não tem poder sobre seu próprio corpo, mas sim o marido; e também da mesma maneira o marido não tem poder sobre seu próprio corpo, mas sim a mulher.

versos.grego: μὴ ἀποστερεῖτε ἀλλήλους, εἰ μήτι ἂν ἐκ συμφώνου πρὸς καιρὸν ἵνα σχολάσητε τῇ προσευχῇ καὶ πάλιν ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ ἦτε, ἵνα μὴ πειράζῃ ὑμᾶς ὁ Σατανᾶς διὰ τὴν ἀκρασίαν ὑμῶν.

controles.web: Don’t deprive one another, unless it is by consent for a season, that you may give yourselves to fasting and prayer, and may be together again, that Satan doesn’t tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
controles.kjv: Defraud ye not one the other, except it be with consent for a time, that ye may give yourselves to fasting and prayer; and come together again, that Satan tempt you not for your incontinency.
controles.livre: Não vos priveis um ao outro, a não ser por consentimento de ambos por algum tempo, para que vos ocupeis com jejum, e para a oração; e voltai-vos outra vez a se juntarem, para que Satanás não vos tente, por causa de vossa falta de domínio próprio.

versos.grego: τοῦτο δὲ λέγω κατὰ συνγνώμην, οὐ κατ’ ἐπιταγήν.

controles.web: But this I say by way of concession, not of commandment.
controles.kjv: But I speak this by permission, and not of commandment.
controles.livre: Mas isto vos digo como permissão, não como mandamento.

versos.grego: θέλω δὲ πάντας ἀνθρώπους εἶναι ὡς καὶ ἐμαυτόν· ἀλλὰ ἕκαστος ἴδιον ἔχει χάρισμα ἐκ Θεοῦ, ὁ μὲν οὕτως, ὁ δὲ οὕτως.

controles.web: Yet I wish that all men were like me. However each man has his own gift from God, one of this kind, and another of that kind.
controles.kjv: For I would that all men were even as I myself. But every man hath his proper gift of God, one after this manner, and another after that.
controles.livre: Porque eu queria que todos fossem como eu mesmo; mas cada um tem seu próprio dom de Deus, um de um jeito assim, e outro de um jeito diferente.

versos.grego: Λέγω δὲ τοῖς ἀγάμοις καὶ ταῖς χήραις, καλὸν αὐτοῖς ἐὰν μείνωσιν ὡς κἀγώ·

controles.web: But I say to the unmarried and to widows, it is good for them if they remain even as I am.
controles.kjv: I say therefore to the unmarried and widows, It is good for them if they abide even as I.
controles.livre: Mas digo aos solteiros, e às viúvas que lhes é bom se permanecessem como eu estou.

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ οὐκ ἐγκρατεύονται, γαμησάτωσαν· κρεῖττον γάρ ἐστιν γαμεῖν ἢ πυροῦσθαι.

controles.web: But if they don’t have self-control, let them marry. For it’s better to marry than to burn.
controles.kjv: But if they cannot contain, let them marry: for it is better to marry than to burn.
controles.livre: Mas se não podem se conter, casem-se; porque é melhor se casar do que se inflamar.

versos.grego: τοῖς δὲ γεγαμηκόσιν παραγγέλλω, οὐκ ἐγὼ ἀλλὰ ὁ Κύριος, γυναῖκα ἀπὸ ἀνδρὸς μὴ χωρισθῆναι,—

controles.web: But to the married I command—not I, but the Lord—that the wife not leave her husband
controles.kjv: And unto the married I command, yet not I, but the Lord, Let not the wife depart from her husband:
controles.livre: Porém aos casados eu mando, não eu, mas o Senhor, que a mulher não se separe do marido.

versos.grego: ἐὰν δὲ καὶ χωρισθῇ, μενέτω ἄγαμος ἢ τῷ ἀνδρὶ καταλλαγήτω,— καὶ ἄνδρα γυναῖκα μὴ ἀφιέναι.

controles.web: (but if she departs, let her remain unmarried, or else be reconciled to her husband), and that the husband not leave his wife.
controles.kjv: But and if she depart, let her remain unmarried, or be reconciled to her husband: and let not the husband put away his wife.
controles.livre: E se se separar, fique sem casar, ou se reconcilie com o marido; e que o marido não deixe a mulher.

versos.grego: τοῖς δὲ λοιποῖς λέγω ἐγώ, οὐχ ὁ Κύριος· εἴ τις ἀδελφὸς γυναῖκα ἔχει ἄπιστον, καὶ αὕτη συνευδοκεῖ οἰκεῖν μετ’ αὐτοῦ, μὴ ἀφιέτω αὐτήν·

controles.web: But to the rest I—not the Lord—say, if any brother has an unbelieving wife, and she is content to live with him, let him not leave her.
controles.kjv: But to the rest speak I, not the Lord: If any brother hath a wife that believeth not, and she be pleased to dwell with him, let him not put her away.
controles.livre: Mas aos outros digo eu, não o Senhor: se algum irmão tem mulher descrente, e ela consente em habitar com ele, não a deixe.

versos.grego: καὶ γυνὴ ἥτις ἔχει ἄνδρα ἄπιστον, καὶ οὗτος συνευδοκεῖ οἰκεῖν μετ’ αὐτῆς, μὴ ἀφιέτω τὸν ἄνδρα.

controles.web: The woman who has an unbelieving husband, and he is content to live with her, let her not leave her husband.
controles.kjv: And the woman which hath an husband that believeth not, and if he be pleased to dwell with her, let her not leave him.
controles.livre: E se alguma mulher tem marido descrente, e ele consente em habitar com ela, não o deixe.

versos.grego: ἡγίασται γὰρ ὁ ἀνὴρ ὁ ἄπιστος ἐν τῇ γυναικί, καὶ ἡγίασται ἡ γυνὴ ἡ ἄπιστος ἐν τῷ ἀδελφῷ· ἐπεὶ ἄρα τὰ τέκνα ὑμῶν ἀκάθαρτά ἐστιν, νῦν δὲ ἅγιά ἐστιν.

controles.web: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified in the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified in the husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.
controles.kjv: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified by the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified by the husband: else were your children unclean; but now are they holy.
controles.livre: Porque o marido descrente é santificado pela mulher; e a mulher descrente é santificada pelo marido. Pois de outra maneira vossos filhos seriam impuros; porém agora são santos.

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ ὁ ἄπιστος χωρίζεται, χωριζέσθω· οὐ δεδούλωται ὁ ἀδελφὸς ἢ ἡ ἀδελφὴ ἐν τοῖς τοιούτοις· ἐν δὲ εἰρήνῃ κέκληκεν ὑμᾶς ὁ Θεός.

controles.web: Yet if the unbeliever departs, let there be separation. The brother or the sister is not under bondage in such cases, but God has called us in peace.
controles.kjv: But if the unbelieving depart, let him depart. A brother or a sister is not under bondage in such cases: but God hath called us to peace.
controles.livre: Mas se o descrente se separar, separe-se também . Em tal situação o irmão ou a irmã não estão sujeitos à servidão; mas Deus vos chamou para a paz.

versos.grego: τί γὰρ οἶδας, γύναι, εἰ τὸν ἄνδρα σώσεις; ἢ τί οἶδας, ἄνερ, εἰ τὴν γυναῖκα σώσεις;

controles.web: For how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?
controles.kjv: For what knowest thou, O wife, whether thou shalt save thy husband? or how knowest thou, O man, whether thou shalt save thy wife?
controles.livre: Porque o que tu sabes, mulher, se salvarás ao marido? Ou o que tu sabes, marido, se salvarás a mulher?

versos.grego: Εἰ μὴ ἑκάστῳ ὡς μεμέρικεν ὁ Κύριος, ἕκαστον ὡς κέκληκεν ὁ Θεός, οὕτως περιπατείτω. καὶ οὕτως ἐν ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις πάσαις διατάσσομαι.

controles.web: Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies.
controles.kjv: But as God hath distributed to every man, as the Lord hath called every one, so let him walk. And so ordain I in all churches.
controles.livre: Porém cada um ande assim como Deus lhe repartiu, cada um como o Senhor o chamou; e assim ordeno em todas as igrejas.

versos.grego: περιτετμημένος τις ἐκλήθη; μὴ ἐπισπάσθω· ἐν ἀκροβυστίᾳ κέκληταί τις; μὴ περιτεμνέσθω.

controles.web: Was anyone called having been circumcised? Let him not become uncircumcised. Has anyone been called in uncircumcision? Let him not be circumcised.
controles.kjv: Is any man called being circumcised? let him not become uncircumcised. Is any called in uncircumcision? let him not be circumcised.
controles.livre: É alguém chamado, estando já circunciso? Não desfaça a circuncisão. É alguém chamado estando ainda incircunciso? Não se circuncide.

versos.grego: ἡ περιτομὴ οὐδέν ἐστιν, καὶ ἡ ἀκροβυστία οὐδέν ἐστιν, ἀλλὰ τήρησις ἐντολῶν Θεοῦ.

controles.web: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but the keeping of the commandments of God.
controles.kjv: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but the keeping of the commandments of God.
controles.livre: A circuncisão nada vale, e a incircuncisão nada vale; mas o que vale é a obediência aos mandamentos de Deus.

versos.grego: ἕκαστος ἐν τῇ κλήσει ᾗ ἐκλήθη, ἐν ταύτῃ μενέτω.

controles.web: Let each man stay in that calling in which he was called.
controles.kjv: Let every man abide in the same calling wherein he was called.
controles.livre: Cada um fique no propósito em que foi chamado.

versos.grego: δοῦλος ἐκλήθης; μή σοι μελέτω· ἀλλ’ εἰ καὶ δύνασαι ἐλεύθερος γενέσθαι, μᾶλλον χρῆσαι.

controles.web: Were you called being a bondservant? Don’t let that bother you, but if you get an opportunity to become free, use it.
controles.kjv: Art thou called being a servant? care not for it: but if thou mayest be made free, use it rather.
controles.livre: Foste tu chamado sendo escravo? Não te preocupes com isto ; mas se tu podes te tornares livre, aproveita.

versos.grego: ὁ γὰρ ἐν Κυρίῳ κληθεὶς δοῦλος ἀπελεύθερος Κυρίου ἐστίν· ὁμοίως ὁ ἐλεύθερος κληθεὶς δοῦλός ἐστιν Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: For he who was called in the Lord being a bondservant is the Lord’s free man. Likewise he who was called being free is Christ’s bondservant.
controles.kjv: For he that is called in the Lord, being a servant, is the Lord’s freeman: likewise also he that is called, being free, is Christ’s servant.
controles.livre: Porque o que foi chamado no Senhor enquanto era escravo, para o Senhor é livre; da mesma maneira também, o que foi chamado, sendo livre, se torna escravo de Cristo.

versos.grego: τιμῆς ἠγοράσθητε· μὴ γίνεσθε δοῦλοι ἀνθρώπων.

controles.web: You were bought with a price. Don’t become bondservants of men.
controles.kjv: Ye are bought with a price; be not ye the servants of men.
controles.livre: Vós fostes comprados por alto preço; portanto não vos façais escravos dos seres humanos.

versos.grego: ἕκαστος ἐν ᾧ ἐκλήθη, ἀδελφοί, ἐν τούτῳ μενέτω παρὰ Θεῷ.

controles.web: Brothers, let each man, in whatever condition he was called, stay in that condition with God.
controles.kjv: Brethren, let every man, wherein he is called, therein abide with God.
controles.livre: Irmãos, cada um continue com Deus no estado em que foi chamado.

versos.grego: Περὶ δὲ τῶν παρθένων ἐπιταγὴν Κυρίου οὐκ ἔχω, γνώμην δὲ δίδωμι ὡς ἠλεημένος ὑπὸ Κυρίου πιστὸς εἶναι.

controles.web: Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy.
controles.kjv: Now concerning virgins I have no commandment of the Lord: yet I give my judgment, as one that hath obtained mercy of the Lord to be faithful.
controles.livre: E quanto às virgens, não tenho mandamento do Senhor; porém eu dou minha opinião, dado que tenho recebido misericórdia do Senhor para que eu seja confiável.

versos.grego: Νομίζω οὖν τοῦτο καλὸν ὑπάρχειν διὰ τὴν ἐνεστῶσαν ἀνάγκην, ὅτι καλὸν ἀνθρώπῳ τὸ οὕτως εἶναι.

controles.web: I think that it is good therefore, because of the distress that is on us, that it is good for a man to be as he is.
controles.kjv: I suppose therefore that this is good for the present distress, I say, that it is good for a man so to be.
controles.livre: Considero pois isto como bom, por causa da necessidade atual, que é bom à pessoa continuar assim como está.

versos.grego: δέδεσαι γυναικί; μὴ ζήτει λύσιν· λέλυσαι ἀπὸ γυναικός; μὴ ζήτει γυναῖκα.

controles.web: Are you bound to a wife? Don’t seek to be freed. Are you free from a wife? Don’t seek a wife.
controles.kjv: Art thou bound unto a wife? seek not to be loosed. Art thou loosed from a wife? seek not a wife.
controles.livre: Estás ligado à mulher, não busques se separar. Estás livre de mulher, não busques mulher.

versos.grego: ἐὰν δὲ καὶ γαμήσῃς, οὐχ ἥμαρτες, καὶ ἐὰν γήμῃ ἡ παρθένος, οὐχ ἥμαρτεν· θλῖψιν δὲ τῇ σαρκὶ ἕξουσιν οἱ τοιοῦτοι, ἐγὼ δὲ ὑμῶν φείδομαι.

controles.web: But if you marry, you have not sinned. If a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Yet such will have oppression in the flesh, and I want to spare you.
controles.kjv: But and if thou marry, thou hast not sinned; and if a virgin marry, she hath not sinned. Nevertheless such shall have trouble in the flesh: but I spare you.
controles.livre: Mas se também te casares, não pecas; e se a virgem se casar, não peca. Porém os tais terão aflições na carne, que eu gostaria de livrá-los.

versos.grego: Τοῦτο δέ φημι, ἀδελφοί, ὁ καιρὸς συνεσταλμένος ἐστίν· τὸ λοιπὸν ἵνα καὶ οἱ ἔχοντες γυναῖκας ὡς μὴ ἔχοντες ὦσιν,

controles.web: But I say this, brothers: the time is short, that from now on, both those who have wives may be as though they had none;
controles.kjv: But this I say, brethren, the time is short: it remaineth, that both they that have wives be as though they had none;
controles.livre: Porém digo isto, irmãos, porque o tempo que resta é breve; para que também os que tem mulheres, sejam como se não as tivessem;

versos.grego: καὶ οἱ κλαίοντες ὡς μὴ κλαίοντες, καὶ οἱ χαίροντες ὡς μὴ χαίροντες, καὶ οἱ ἀγοράζοντες ὡς μὴ κατέχοντες,

controles.web: and those who weep, as though they didn’t weep; and those who rejoice, as though they didn’t rejoice; and those who buy, as though they didn’t possess;
controles.kjv: And they that weep, as though they wept not; and they that rejoice, as though they rejoiced not; and they that buy, as though they possessed not;
controles.livre: E os que choram, como se não chorassem; e os que se alegram, como se não se alegrassem; e os que compram, como se não possuíssem.

versos.grego: καὶ οἱ χρώμενοι τὸν κόσμον ὡς μὴ καταχρώμενοι· παράγει γὰρ τὸ σχῆμα τοῦ κόσμου τούτου.

controles.web: and those who use the world, as not using it to the fullest. For the mode of this world passes away.
controles.kjv: And they that use this world, as not abusing it: for the fashion of this world passeth away.
controles.livre: E os que usam das coisas deste mundo, como se delas não abusassem; porque a aparência deste mundo é passageira.

versos.grego: θέλω δὲ ὑμᾶς ἀμερίμνους εἶναι. ὁ ἄγαμος μεριμνᾷ τὰ τοῦ Κυρίου, πῶς ἀρέσῃ τῷ Κυρίῳ·

controles.web: But I desire to have you to be free from cares. He who is unmarried is concerned for the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord;
controles.kjv: But I would have you without carefulness. He that is unmarried careth for the things that belong to the Lord, how he may please the Lord:
controles.livre: E eu queria que estivésseis sem preocupações. O solteiro se preocupa com as coisas do Senhor, como irá agradar ao Senhor;

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ γαμήσας μεριμνᾷ τὰ τοῦ κόσμου, πῶς ἀρέσῃ τῇ γυναικί,

controles.web: but he who is married is concerned about the things of the world, how he may please his wife.
controles.kjv: But he that is married careth for the things that are of the world, how he may please his wife.
controles.livre: Porém o que é casado se preocupa com as coisas do mundo, como irá agradar à mulher.

versos.grego: καὶ μεμέρισται. καὶ ἡ γυνὴ ἡ ἄγαμος καὶ ἡ παρθένος μεριμνᾷ τὰ τοῦ Κυρίου, ἵνα ᾖ ἁγία καὶ τῷ σώματι καὶ τῷ πνεύματι· ἡ δὲ γαμήσασα μεριμνᾷ τὰ τοῦ κόσμου, πῶς ἀρέσῃ τῷ ἀνδρί.

controles.web: There is also a difference between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But she who is married cares about the things of the world—how she may please her husband.
controles.kjv: There is difference also between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman careth for the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit: but she that is married careth for the things of the world, how she may please her husband.
controles.livre: A mulher casada e a virgem são diferentes: a que está para casar tem preocupação com as coisas do Senhor, para ser santa, tanto de corpo como de Espírito; mas a casada tem preocupação com as coisas do mundo, como irá agradar ao marido.

versos.grego: τοῦτο δὲ πρὸς τὸ ὑμῶν αὐτῶν σύμφορον λέγω, οὐχ ἵνα βρόχον ὑμῖν ἐπιβάλω, ἀλλὰ πρὸς τὸ εὔσχημον καὶ εὐπάρεδρον τῷ Κυρίῳ ἀπερισπάστως.

controles.web: This I say for your own profit; not that I may ensnare you, but for that which is appropriate, and that you may attend to the Lord without distraction.
controles.kjv: And this I speak for your own profit; not that I may cast a snare upon you, but for that which is comely, and that ye may attend upon the Lord without distraction.
controles.livre: Porém digo isto para vosso próprio proveito; não para vos enlaçar, mas para vos guiar ao que é decente, e servirem ao Senhor sem distração.

versos.grego: Εἰ δέ τις ἀσχημονεῖν ἐπὶ τὴν παρθένον αὐτοῦ νομίζει, ἐὰν ᾖ ὑπέρακμος, καὶ οὕτως ὀφείλει γίνεσθαι, ὃ θέλει ποιείτω· οὐχ ἁμαρτάνει· γαμείτωσαν.

controles.web: But if any man thinks that he is behaving inappropriately toward his virgin, if she is past the flower of her age, and if need so requires, let him do what he desires. He doesn’t sin. Let them marry.
controles.kjv: But if any man think that he behaveth himself uncomely toward his virgin, if she pass the flower of her age, and need so require, let him do what he will, he sinneth not: let them marry.
controles.livre: Mas se alguém lhe parece que indecentemente trata com sua virgem, se ela passar da idade da juventude, e assim convier se fazer, que tal faça o que quiser, não peca, casem-se.

versos.grego: ὃς δὲ ἕστηκεν ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ ἑδραῖος μὴ ἔχων ἀνάγκην, ἐξουσίαν δὲ ἔχει περὶ τοῦ ἰδίου θελήματος, καὶ τοῦτο κέκρικεν ἐν τῇ ἰδίᾳ καρδίᾳ, τηρεῖν τὴν ἑαυτοῦ παρθένον, καλῶς ποιήσει.

controles.web: But he who stands steadfast in his heart, having no necessity, but has power over his own heart, to keep his own virgin, does well.
controles.kjv: Nevertheless he that standeth stedfast in his heart, having no necessity, but hath power over his own will, and hath so decreed in his heart that he will keep his virgin, doeth well.
controles.livre: Porém o que está firme em seu coração, não tendo necessidade, mas tem poder sobre sua própria vontade, e isto decidiu em seu próprio coração, de guardar sua virgem, faz bem.

versos.grego: ὥστε καὶ ὁ γαμίζων τὴν ἑαυτοῦ παρθένον καλῶς ποιεῖ, καὶ ὁ μὴ γαμίζων κρεῖσσον ποιήσει.

controles.web: So then both he who gives his own virgin in marriage does well, and he who doesn’t give her in marriage does better.
controles.kjv: So then he that giveth her in marriage doeth well; but he that giveth her not in marriage doeth better.
controles.livre: Portanto, o que a dá em casamento, faz bem; mas o que não a dá em casamento, faz melhor.

versos.grego: Γυνὴ δέδεται ἐφ’ ὅσον χρόνον ζῇ ὁ ἀνὴρ αὐτῆς· ἐὰν δὲ κοιμηθῇ ὁ ἀνήρ, ἐλευθέρα ἐστὶν ᾧ θέλει γαμηθῆναι, μόνον ἐν Κυρίῳ·

controles.web: A wife is bound by law for as long as her husband lives; but if the husband is dead, she is free to be married to whomever she desires, only in the Lord.
controles.kjv: The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty to be married to whom she will; only in the Lord.
controles.livre: A mulher casada está ligada pela Lei todo o tempo em que seu marido vive; mas se seu marido morrer, fica livre para se casar com quem quiser, contanto que seja no Senhor.

versos.grego: μακαριωτέρα δέ ἐστιν ἐὰν οὕτως μείνῃ, κατὰ τὴν ἐμὴν γνώμην· δοκῶ δὲ κἀγὼ Πνεῦμα Θεοῦ ἔχειν.

controles.web: But she is happier if she stays as she is, in my judgment, and I think that I also have God’s Spirit.
controles.kjv: But she is happier if she so abide, after my judgment: and I think also that I have the Spirit of God.
controles.livre: Porém mais bem-aventurada é, se assim continuar, segundo minha opinião. E também eu penso, que tenho o Espírito de Deus.
